canonical_statement: For every complex Hilbert space with a Hilbert basis indexed by Nat, every pure state on the star subalgebra of operators diagonal in that basis has exactly one state extension to all bounded operators.
domain_and_universes: H : Type u; complex complete inner-product space; basis : HilbertBasis Nat Complex H; diagonal : StarSubalgebra Complex (H ->L[Complex] H)
ordered_binders: off-diagonal matrix coefficients vanish exactly on diagonal
conclusion: There exists exactly one normalized positive complex-linear functional on Operators H whose restriction along the diagonal subtype inclusion is phi.
